objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed document (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the document in the document pyramid (1-4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in the document name.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the current released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Configured period for validity extension check (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configured period for archive retention (default 10 years).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data or IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity assigned to the document.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Clients in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A non-controlled document supplement that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether the additional information has been directly published via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal to amend an existing released document, created by any user with author rights.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Content of the proposed change.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check and extend the validity of a document before it expires.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate (put out of force) a released document and archive it.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to reactivate an archived (invalidated) document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document management activities in various roles.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users used for authorization and distribution assignments.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user group (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Archive).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type or purpose of the group (reader, author, reviewer, releaser, archive, etc.).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for notification upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A workflow instance that controls the processing of a release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement process.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation release, acknowledgement).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Source format of the template (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is attached/created in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_metadata
evts.description: Document properties and metadata are maintained or updated.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The metadata category being edited (e.g. Master data, Control).

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically converted to PDF after saving.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs in the Creator step of the release workflow with electronic signature.

attributes.name: signature
attributes.description: Electronic signature of the author.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness within the release workflow.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Technical or formal review.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Positive completion or rejection.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document within the release workflow.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Positive completion or rejection.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason for rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The document is automatically published after release and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content or attribute changes.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for the new version (content change, attachment change, change proposal, etc.).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is created and linked to a main document.

evts.name: edit_attachment
evts.description: The content or properties of an existing attachment are modified.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon next main document release.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: A new additional information object is added to a document.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is published directly via property switches.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is documented as completed by the author.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before document expiry.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension request is processed via workflow by releasers (and optionally author/reviewer).

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Extend validity, revise, or invalidate.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity is extended and the Valid Until date is updated.

attributes.name: new_valid_until
attributes.description: Updated expiration date after extension.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed via workflow with review and release steps.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Approve or reject the override.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force; authorizations are revoked except for archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin user creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation request is confirmed via workflow, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read, write).

evts.name: assign_role
evts.description: A user is assigned to a role on a document (author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator).

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The role being assigned.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email upon document release.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested to confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a released document via workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language the document is translated into.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is checked and released via workflow.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Approval or rejection of the translation.

evts.name: physical_delete
evts.description: An archived document is physically deleted after the archive retention period expires.
